title: Time & aspect edge cases
note: future perfect, progressive future, be to, was to have · thin shell night/2026-08-05

items.en: By next year we will have finished the project.
items.gap: By next year we will ____ finished the project.
accepts: By next year we will have finished the project.

items.en: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Rome.
items.cz: Zítra touhle dobou budu letět do Říma.
items.gap: This time tomorrow I will ____ flying to Rome.
accepts: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Rome.

items.en: The meeting is to start at nine.
items.gap: The meeting is ____ start at nine.
accepts: The meeting is to start at nine.

items.en: He was to have spoken, but fell ill.
items.gap: He was to ____ spoken, but fell ill.
accepts: He was to have spoken, but fell ill.
items.explanation: was to have + PP: unfulfilled plan.
items.explanation_cz: was to have + 3. tvar: nesplněný plán.

items.en: I will have been working here for ten years in May.
items.cz: V květnu tu budu pracovat deset let.
items.gap: I will have been ____ here for ten years in May.
accepts: I will have been working here for ten years in May.

items.en: She is always complaining about traffic.
accepts: She is always complaining about traffic.

items.en: I was just going to call you.
items.gap: I was just ____ to call you.
accepts: I was just going to call you.
items.explanation: was just going to: interrupted intention.
items.explanation_cz: was just going to: přerušený záměr.

items.en: By the time you arrive, we will have left.
items.gap: By the time you arrive, we will ____ left.
accepts: By the time you arrive, we will have left.

items.en: We were due to land at six.
items.gap: We were due ____ land at six.
accepts: We were due to land at six.
